author: Susan Powell
text: Provides great service with competitive rates.  Offers discounts for elderly and military.  Locally owned and operated.  Very professional guys that came out to service our tank.  Highly recommend.

author: Molly Hammond
text: I do not recommend Pickle Septic Tank and Plumbing. We had them come out for a job, that was completed and has had no issues, that is why I give it 3 stars. They did however, break the steps on my deck, left a huge hole under my deck that I was not made aware of, they showed up unannounced the second day. Never called and said they were coming or that they were there, we only found out because of our security cameras. They also proceeded to leave all their lunch trash and bottles under my deck. It also took the front desk a considerable amount of time to find us in their system every time we called. They never had heard of us or didn't have us in their system... we called two days in a row and she couldn't remember or find us. Just not professional in any way.

author: kimberly mcghee
text: My parents was loyal customers to this company but not anymore. My experience was way last than great. Mater of fact I never got an experience because of their unprofessional unorganized schedule who schedule our appointment wrong the first time then canceled and after talking to her again to reschedule she tells me a date and time once again so my husband takes off work a second time to wait for them and once again they dont show because she fails to put us on their schedule. She then proceeded to call us liars and say we never spoke to her yet she gives us the numbers back that we called her from. So for those reasons they have lost about 5 customers.

author: Janice P. Williams
text: I received excellent service today. The technicians called and gave me a time to expect them, and they were there on time. The technicians were very knowledgeable and professional. My property was left neat and orderly.  I would recommend them to anyone needing their services.

author: Harley Harper
text: One of our bathrooms started backing up the Sunday before Christmas. Having family visiting didnt help things. I called Wayne Pickle Septic Tank and they came out first thing Monday morning.  Their crew was on time, friendly, and professional. It turns out that my septic tank didnt need cleaning (it was cleaned out just a couple years ago) and that the problem was a clog in the pipe going to the tank. Apparently flushing makeup removal or baby wipes down is bad even though the package says they are flushable. They dont degrade and can clog pipes which is what happened to us. They were able to get the pipe unclogged quickly and only charged a small fee to do so. We are very thankful for their help and will definitely recommend using this company!
